import YulangClosure.HigherOrderHandlerSyntax

namespace YulangClosure.HigherOrder.Handler
open YulangClosure.HigherOrder (Ty Context emptyContext extend OperationInstance
  ViewOccurrence ReceiptTemplate PathCorrespondence)

/-! Actual raw higher-order shallow handler transitions. This is candidate
value typing, not the effect/permission or activation-freshening theorem. -/

deriving instance DecidableEq for Ty
deriving instance DecidableEq for OperationInstance

/-- Source application evaluates the callee first. The argument is shifted out
of the fresh callee binder before being delayed. -/
def sourceApply (callee argument : Comp) : Comp :=
  .bind callee (.dynamicCall (.var 0) (.delay (renameComp Nat.succ argument)))

theorem sourceApply_typed (hf : CompTyped env callee (.callable a b))
    (ha : CompTyped env argument a) : CompTyped env (sourceApply callee argument) b :=
  .bind hf (.dynamicCall (.var rfl) (.delay (renameComp_typed ha (fun _ _ h => h))))

/-- Projection used only for a typed computation construction. Full adapters
remain in the plans below; this is not operational metadata erasure. -/
def adapterBody : Adapter → Comp
  | .mk _ _ body _ _ => body

theorem adapterBody_typed (h : AdapterTyped env adapter a b) :
    CompTyped (extend env a) (adapterBody adapter) b := by
  cases h with
  | mk h => exact h

def applyAdapter (adapter : Adapter) (v : Value) : Comp :=
  substComp (single v) (adapterBody adapter)

theorem applyAdapter_typed (h : AdapterTyped env adapter a b)
    (hv : ValueTyped env v a) : CompTyped env (applyAdapter adapter v) b :=
  substitute_top (adapterBody_typed h) hv

def consumeResult (body : Comp) (consumer : Adapter) : Comp :=
  .bind body (adapterBody consumer)

theorem consumeResult_typed (hb : CompTyped env body b)
    (hc : AdapterTyped env consumer b r) : CompTyped env (consumeResult body consumer) r :=
  .bind hb (adapterBody_typed hc)

/-- Value entry forces the carrier, then binds its value into the body. -/
def valueEntry (body : Comp) (carrier : Value) : Comp := .bind (.force carrier) body

theorem valueEntry_typed (hb : CompTyped (extend env a) body b)
    (hc : ValueTyped env carrier (.thunk a)) : CompTyped env (valueEntry body carrier) b :=
  .bind (.force hc) hb

/-- Computation entry substitutes the carrier itself; no force is inserted. -/
def computationEntry (body : Comp) (carrier : Value) : Comp := substComp (single carrier) body

theorem computationEntry_typed (hb : CompTyped (extend env (.thunk a)) body b)
    (hc : ValueTyped env carrier (.thunk a)) : CompTyped env (computationEntry body carrier) b :=
  substitute_top hb hc

structure LambdaEntryPlan where
  mode : Original.Mode
  receipt : ReceiptTemplate
  argument : Ty
  bodyResult : Ty
  result : Ty
  body : Comp
  consumer : Adapter
  carrier : Value

def LambdaEntryPlan.computation (p : LambdaEntryPlan) : Comp :=
  consumeResult
    (match p.mode with
    | .value => valueEntry p.body p.carrier
    | .computation => computationEntry p.body p.carrier)
    p.consumer

theorem lambda_value_plan_typed (receipt : ReceiptTemplate)
    (hb : CompTyped (extend env a) body b) (hc : AdapterTyped env consumer b r)
    (ha : ValueTyped env carrier (.thunk a)) :
    CompTyped env (LambdaEntryPlan.computation
      ⟨.value, receipt, a, b, r, body, consumer, carrier⟩) r :=
  consumeResult_typed (valueEntry_typed hb ha) hc

theorem lambda_computation_plan_typed (receipt : ReceiptTemplate)
    (hb : CompTyped (extend env (.thunk a)) body b) (hc : AdapterTyped env consumer b r)
    (ha : ValueTyped env carrier (.thunk a)) :
    CompTyped env (LambdaEntryPlan.computation
      ⟨.computation, receipt, a, b, r, body, consumer, carrier⟩) r :=
  consumeResult_typed (computationEntry_typed hb ha) hc

/-- Input adaptation runs inside the delayed carrier. The output adapter runs
on the inner call's returned value. Entire adapter metadata is retained. -/
structure WrapEntryPlan where
  inner : Value
  input : Adapter
  output : Adapter
  carrier : Value

def WrapEntryPlan.computation (p : WrapEntryPlan) : Comp :=
  consumeResult
    (.dynamicCall p.inner (.delay (.bind (.force p.carrier) (adapterBody p.input))))
    p.output

theorem wrap_plan_typed (hf : ValueTyped env inner (.callable a b))
    (hi : AdapterTyped env input c a) (ho : AdapterTyped env output b d)
    (hc : ValueTyped env carrier (.thunk c)) :
    CompTyped env (WrapEntryPlan.computation ⟨inner, input, output, carrier⟩) d :=
  consumeResult_typed
    (.dynamicCall hf (.delay (.bind (.force hc) (adapterBody_typed hi)))) ho

inductive ThunkForm : Value → Prop where
  | delay (body : Comp) : ThunkForm (.delay body)
  | view : ThunkForm v → ThunkForm (.view v occurrence)

inductive CallableForm : Value → Prop where
  | lambda (mode receipt a b r body consumer) :
      CallableForm (.lambda mode receipt a b r body consumer)
  | wrap : CallableForm f → CallableForm (.wrap f input output)
  | view : CallableForm v → CallableForm (.view v occurrence)

inductive UnionForm : Value → Prop where
  | left (v : Value) : UnionForm (.inLeft v)
  | right (v : Value) : UnionForm (.inRight v)
  | view : UnionForm v → UnionForm (.view v occurrence)

inductive IntersectionForm : Value → Prop where
  | both (v : Value) : IntersectionForm (.both v)
  | view : IntersectionForm v → IntersectionForm (.view v occurrence)

theorem thunk_canonical (h : ValueTyped emptyContext v (.thunk a)) : ThunkForm v := by
  cases h with
  | var h => cases h
  | delay _ => exact .delay _
  | view h => exact .view (thunk_canonical h)

theorem callable_canonical (h : ValueTyped emptyContext v (.callable a b)) : CallableForm v := by
  cases h with
  | var h => cases h
  | lambdaValue _ _ => exact .lambda _ _ _ _ _ _ _
  | lambdaComputation _ _ => exact .lambda _ _ _ _ _ _ _
  | wrap h _ _ => exact .wrap (callable_canonical h)
  | view h => exact .view (callable_canonical h)

theorem union_canonical (h : ValueTyped emptyContext v (.union a b)) : UnionForm v := by
  cases h with
  | var h => cases h
  | inLeft _ => exact .left _
  | inRight _ => exact .right _
  | view h => exact .view (union_canonical h)

theorem intersection_canonical (h : ValueTyped emptyContext v (.intersection a b)) :
    IntersectionForm v := by
  cases h with
  | var h => cases h
  | both _ _ => exact .both _
  | view h => exact .view (intersection_canonical h)

theorem bottom_empty (h : ValueTyped emptyContext v .bottom) : False := by
  cases h with
  | var h => cases h
  | view h => exact bottom_empty h


def Handler.input : Handler → Ty
  | .mk _ a _ _ _ => a

def Handler.values : Handler → ValueArms
  | .mk _ _ _ vs _ => vs

def Handler.operations : Handler → OperationArms
  | .mk _ _ _ _ os => os

theorem handler_input (hh : HandlerTyped env h a b) : h.input = a := by
  cases hh
  rfl

theorem handler_values (hh : HandlerTyped env h a b) : ValueArmsTyped env h.values a b := by
  cases hh with
  | mk hv _ => exact hv

theorem handler_operations (hh : HandlerTyped env h a b) : OperationArmsTyped env h.operations a b := by
  cases hh with
  | mk _ ho => exact ho

/-- A concrete callable encoding of K. Its actual response binder is the
lambda parameter, and its result adapter is the identity computation. -/
def continuationValue (q a : Ty) (k : Comp) : Value :=
  .lambda .value ⟨[], []⟩ q a a k (.mk a a (.ret (.var 0)) [] [])

theorem continuationValue_typed (hk : CompTyped (extend env q) k a) :
    ValueTyped env (continuationValue q a k) (.callable q a) :=
  .lambdaValue hk (.mk (.ret (.var rfl)))

def pairSubstitution (payload continuation : Value) : Nat → Value
  | 0 => payload
  | 1 => continuation
  | n+2 => .var n

theorem substitute_pair
    (hb : CompTyped (extend (extend env kty) pty) body b)
    (hp : ValueTyped env p pty) (hk : ValueTyped env k kty) :
    CompTyped env (substComp (pairSubstitution p k) body) b := by
  apply substComp_typed hb
  intro i t hi
  cases i with
  | zero =>
      simp only [extend, Option.some.injEq] at hi
      subst t
      exact hp
  | succ i =>
      cases i with
      | zero =>
          simp only [extend, Option.some.injEq] at hi
          subst t
          exact hk
      | succ i => exact .var hi

def attemptOperation (h : Handler) (op : OperationInstance) (p : Value) (k body : Comp) : Comp :=
  substComp (pairSubstitution p (continuationValue op.responseType h.input k)) body

theorem attemptOperation_typed (hh : HandlerTyped env h a b)
    (hp : ValueTyped env p op.payloadType) (hk : CompTyped (extend env op.responseType) k a)
    (hb : CompTyped (extend (extend env (.callable op.responseType a)) op.payloadType)
      body (.union (.base .unit) b)) :
    CompTyped env (attemptOperation h op p k body) (.union (.base .unit) b) := by
  unfold attemptOperation
  rw [handler_input hh]
  exact substitute_pair hb hp (continuationValue_typed hk)

/-- H K is separately constructed by reinstating the shifted handler under
K's response binder. It is never passed to a selected operation arm. -/
def forwardedContinuation (h : Handler) (k : Comp) : Comp :=
  .handle (renameHandler Nat.succ h) k

theorem forwardedContinuation_typed (hh : HandlerTyped env h a b)
    (hk : CompTyped (extend env q) k a) :
    CompTyped (extend env q) (forwardedContinuation h k) b :=
  .handle (renameHandler_typed hh (fun _ _ h => h)) hk

inductive Event where
  | silent
  | observeView (occurrence : ViewOccurrence)
  | lambdaEntry (plan : LambdaEntryPlan)
  | wrapEntry (plan : WrapEntryPlan)
  | leaveScope (owner : Nat)
  | leaveExpose (effectView resultView : ViewOccurrence)

inductive Step : Comp → Event → Comp → Prop where
  | force : Step (.force (.delay body)) .silent body
  | forceView : Step (.force (.view v o)) (.observeView o) (.force v)
  | bindReturn : Step (.bind (.ret v) body) .silent (substComp (single v) body)
  | bind : Step m e n → Step (.bind m body) e (.bind n body)
  | unionLeft : Step (.unionCase (.inLeft v) l r) .silent (substComp (single v) l)
  | unionRight : Step (.unionCase (.inRight v) l r) .silent (substComp (single v) r)
  | unionView : Step (.unionCase (.view v o) l r) (.observeView o) (.unionCase v l r)
  | chooseLeft : Step (.chooseLeft (.both v)) .silent (.ret v)
  | chooseRight : Step (.chooseRight (.both v)) .silent (.ret v)
  | chooseLeftView : Step (.chooseLeft (.view v o)) (.observeView o) (.chooseLeft v)
  | chooseRightView : Step (.chooseRight (.view v o)) (.observeView o) (.chooseRight v)
  | scope : Step m e n → Step (.scope owner m) e (.scope owner n)
  | scopeReturn : Step (.scope owner (.ret v)) (.leaveScope owner) (.ret v)
  | expose : Step m e n → Step (.expose ev rv m) e (.expose ev rv n)
  | exposeReturn : Step (.expose ev rv (.ret v)) (.leaveExpose ev rv) (.ret v)
  | callView : Step (.dynamicCall (.view f o) arg) (.observeView o) (.dynamicCall f arg)
  | callLambda :
      Step (.dynamicCall (.lambda mode receipt a b r body consumer) carrier)
        (.lambdaEntry ⟨mode, receipt, a, b, r, body, consumer, carrier⟩)
        (LambdaEntryPlan.computation ⟨mode, receipt, a, b, r, body, consumer, carrier⟩)
  | callWrap :
      Step (.dynamicCall (.wrap inner input output) carrier)
        (.wrapEntry ⟨inner, input, output, carrier⟩)
        (WrapEntryPlan.computation ⟨inner, input, output, carrier⟩)

  | bindRequest : Step (.bind (.request op p k) body) .silent
      (.request op p (.bind k (renameComp (Original.up Nat.succ) body)))
  | bindFail : Step (.bind (.fail reason) body) .silent (.fail reason)
  | scopeRequest : Step (.scope owner (.request op p k)) .silent
      (.request op p (.scope owner k))
  | scopeFail : Step (.scope owner (.fail reason)) .silent (.fail reason)
  | exposeRequest : Step (.expose ev rv (.request op p k)) .silent
      (.request op p (.expose ev rv k))
  | exposeFail : Step (.expose ev rv (.fail reason)) .silent (.fail reason)
  | handle : Step m e n → Step (.handle h m) e (.handle h n)
  | handleReturn : Step (.handle h (.ret v)) .silent (.tryValue h v h.values)
  | handleRequest : Step (.handle h (.request op p k)) .silent
      (.tryOperation h op p k h.operations)
  | handleFail : Step (.handle h (.fail reason)) .silent (.fail reason)
  | valueEmpty : Step (.tryValue h v .nil) .silent (.fail .matchFailure)
  | valueCons : Step (.tryValue h v (.cons body rest)) .silent
      (.waitValue h v rest (substComp (single v) body))
  | valueWait : Step m e n → Step (.waitValue h v rest m) e (.waitValue h v rest n)
  | valueYes : Step (.waitValue h v rest (.ret (.inRight result))) .silent (.ret result)
  | valueNo : Step (.waitValue h v rest (.ret (.inLeft unit))) .silent (.tryValue h v rest)
  | valueView : Step (.waitValue h v rest (.ret (.view result o))) (.observeView o)
      (.waitValue h v rest (.ret result))
  | valueFail : Step (.waitValue h v rest (.fail reason)) .silent (.fail reason)
  | valueRequest : Step (.waitValue h v rest (.request op p k)) .silent
      (.request op p (.waitValue (renameHandler Nat.succ h) (renameValue Nat.succ v)
        (renameValueArms Nat.succ rest) k))
  | operationEmpty : Step (.tryOperation h op p k .nil) .silent
      (.request op p (forwardedContinuation h k))
  | operationCons : Step (.tryOperation h op p k (.cons op true body rest)) .silent
      (.waitOperation h op p k rest (attemptOperation h op p k body))
  | operationSkip : (armOp ≠ op ∨ eligible = false) →
      Step (.tryOperation h op p k (.cons armOp eligible body rest)) .silent
        (.tryOperation h op p k rest)
  | operationWait : Step m e n →
      Step (.waitOperation h op p k rest m) e (.waitOperation h op p k rest n)
  | operationYes : Step (.waitOperation h op p k rest (.ret (.inRight result))) .silent (.ret result)
  | operationNo : Step (.waitOperation h op p k rest (.ret (.inLeft unit))) .silent
      (.tryOperation h op p k rest)
  | operationView : Step (.waitOperation h op p k rest (.ret (.view result o))) (.observeView o)
      (.waitOperation h op p k rest (.ret result))
  | operationFail : Step (.waitOperation h op p k rest (.fail reason)) .silent (.fail reason)
  | operationRequest : Step (.waitOperation h op p k rest (.request nextOp nextP nextK)) .silent
      (.request nextOp nextP (.waitOperation (renameHandler Nat.succ h) op
        (renameValue Nat.succ p) (renameComp (Original.up Nat.succ) k)
        (renameOperationArms Nat.succ rest) nextK))

theorem preservation (step : Step m e n) (h : CompTyped env m a) : CompTyped env n a := by
  induction step generalizing env a with
  | force =>
      cases h with
      | force hv => cases hv with | delay hb => exact hb
  | forceView =>
      cases h with
      | force hv => cases hv with | view hv => exact .force hv
  | bindReturn =>
      cases h with
      | bind hv hb => cases hv with | ret hv => exact substitute_top hb hv
  | bind _ ih =>
      cases h with
      | bind hm hb => exact .bind (ih hm) hb
  | unionLeft =>
      cases h with
      | unionCase hv hl _ => cases hv with | inLeft hv => exact substitute_top hl hv
  | unionRight =>
      cases h with
      | unionCase hv _ hr => cases hv with | inRight hv => exact substitute_top hr hv
  | unionView =>
      cases h with
      | unionCase hv hl hr => cases hv with | view hv => exact .unionCase hv hl hr
  | chooseLeft =>
      cases h with
      | chooseLeft hv => cases hv with | both hl _ => exact .ret hl
  | chooseRight =>
      cases h with
      | chooseRight hv => cases hv with | both _ hr => exact .ret hr
  | chooseLeftView =>
      cases h with
      | chooseLeft hv => cases hv with | view hv => exact .chooseLeft hv
  | chooseRightView =>
      cases h with
      | chooseRight hv => cases hv with | view hv => exact .chooseRight hv
  | scope _ ih =>
      cases h with
      | scope hm => exact .scope (ih hm)
  | scopeReturn =>
      cases h with
      | scope hm => exact hm
  | expose _ ih =>
      cases h with
      | expose hm => exact .expose (ih hm)
  | exposeReturn =>
      cases h with
      | expose hm => exact hm
  | callView =>
      cases h with
      | dynamicCall hf ha => cases hf with | view hf => exact .dynamicCall hf ha
  | callLambda =>
      cases h with
      | dynamicCall hf ha =>
          cases hf with
          | lambdaValue hb hc => exact lambda_value_plan_typed _ hb hc ha
          | lambdaComputation hb hc => exact lambda_computation_plan_typed _ hb hc ha
  | callWrap =>
      cases h with
      | dynamicCall hf ha =>
          cases hf with
          | wrap hf hi ho => exact wrap_plan_typed hf hi ho ha

  | bindRequest =>
      cases h with
      | bind hm hb => cases hm with
        | request hp hk => exact .request hp (.bind hk (renameComp_typed hb (up_typed (env := env) (target := extend env _) (r := Nat.succ) (fun _ _ h => h) _)))
  | bindFail => exact .fail
  | scopeRequest =>
      cases h with
      | scope hm => cases hm with
        | request hp hk => exact .request hp (.scope hk)
  | scopeFail => exact .fail
  | exposeRequest =>
      cases h with
      | expose hm => cases hm with
        | request hp hk => exact .request hp (.expose hk)
  | exposeFail => exact .fail
  | handle _ ih =>
      cases h with
      | handle hh hm => exact .handle hh (ih hm)
  | handleReturn =>
      cases h with
      | handle hh hm => cases hm with
        | ret hv => exact .tryValue hh hv (handler_values hh)
  | handleRequest =>
      cases h with
      | handle hh hm => cases hm with
        | request hp hk => exact .tryOperation hh hp hk (handler_operations hh)
  | handleFail => exact .fail
  | valueEmpty => exact .fail
  | valueCons =>
      cases h with
      | tryValue hh hv hs => cases hs with
        | cons hb hr => exact .waitValue hh hv hr (substitute_top hb hv)
  | valueWait _ ih =>
      cases h with
      | waitValue hh hv hr hm => exact .waitValue hh hv hr (ih hm)
  | valueYes =>
      cases h with
      | waitValue _ _ _ hm => cases hm with
        | ret hv => cases hv with
          | inRight hv => exact .ret hv
  | valueNo =>
      cases h with
      | waitValue hh hv hr _ => exact .tryValue hh hv hr
  | valueView =>
      cases h with
      | waitValue hh hv hr hm => cases hm with
        | ret hv' => cases hv' with
          | view hv' => exact .waitValue hh hv hr (.ret hv')
  | valueFail => exact .fail
  | valueRequest =>
      cases h with
      | waitValue hh hv hr hm => cases hm with
        | request hp hk => exact .request hp (.waitValue
            (renameHandler_typed hh (fun _ _ h => h))
            (renameValue_typed hv (fun _ _ h => h))
            (renameValueArms_typed hr (fun _ _ h => h)) hk)
  | operationEmpty =>
      cases h with
      | tryOperation hh hp hk _ => exact .request hp (forwardedContinuation_typed hh hk)
  | operationCons =>
      cases h with
      | tryOperation hh hp hk hs => cases hs with
        | cons hb hr => exact .waitOperation hh hp hk hr (attemptOperation_typed hh hp hk hb)
  | operationSkip _ =>
      cases h with
      | tryOperation hh hp hk hs => cases hs with
        | cons _ hr => exact .tryOperation hh hp hk hr
  | operationWait _ ih =>
      cases h with
      | waitOperation hh hp hk hr hm => exact .waitOperation hh hp hk hr (ih hm)
  | operationYes =>
      cases h with
      | waitOperation _ _ _ _ hm => cases hm with
        | ret hv => cases hv with
          | inRight hv => exact .ret hv
  | operationNo =>
      cases h with
      | waitOperation hh hp hk hr _ => exact .tryOperation hh hp hk hr
  | operationView =>
      cases h with
      | waitOperation hh hp hk hr hm => cases hm with
        | ret hv => cases hv with
          | view hv => exact .waitOperation hh hp hk hr (.ret hv)
  | operationFail => exact .fail
  | operationRequest =>
      cases h with
      | waitOperation hh hp hk hr hm => cases hm with
        | request hp' hk' => exact .request hp' (.waitOperation
            (renameHandler_typed hh (fun _ _ h => h))
            (renameValue_typed hp (fun _ _ h => h))
            (renameComp_typed hk (up_typed (env := env) (target := extend env _) (r := Nat.succ) (fun _ _ h => h) _))
            (renameOperationArms_typed hr (fun _ _ h => h)) hk')

/-- The terminal alternatives are only the three concrete outer constructors;
requests and failures underneath a frame must take their propagation step. -/
inductive Terminal : Comp → Prop where
  | returned (v : Value) : Terminal (.ret v)
  | requested (op p k) : Terminal (.request op p k)
  | failed (reason) : Terminal (.fail reason)

def CanProgress (m : Comp) : Prop := Terminal m ∨ ∃ e n, Step m e n

theorem operation_trials_progress (h : Handler) (op : OperationInstance)
    (p : Value) (k : Comp) (arms : OperationArms) : CanProgress (.tryOperation h op p k arms) := by
  cases arms with
  | nil => exact .inr ⟨_, _, .operationEmpty⟩
  | cons armOp eligible body rest =>
      cases eligible with
      | false => exact .inr ⟨_, _, .operationSkip (.inr rfl)⟩
      | true =>
          by_cases equal : armOp = op
          · subst armOp
            exact .inr ⟨_, _, .operationCons⟩
          · exact .inr ⟨_, _, .operationSkip (.inl equal)⟩

theorem closed_progress (h : CompTyped emptyContext m a) : CanProgress m := by
  cases h with
  | ret _ => exact .inl (.returned _)
  | request _ _ => exact .inl (.requested _ _ _)
  | fail => exact .inl (.failed _)
  | force hv =>
      cases thunk_canonical hv with
      | delay _ => exact .inr ⟨_, _, .force⟩
      | view _ => exact .inr ⟨_, _, .forceView⟩
  | bind hm hb =>
      rcases closed_progress hm with terminal | ⟨e, n, step⟩
      · cases terminal with
        | returned _ => exact .inr ⟨_, _, .bindReturn⟩
        | requested _ _ _ => exact .inr ⟨_, _, .bindRequest⟩
        | failed _ => exact .inr ⟨_, _, .bindFail⟩
      · exact .inr ⟨e, _, .bind step⟩
  | unionCase hv hl hr =>
      cases union_canonical hv with
      | left _ => exact .inr ⟨_, _, .unionLeft⟩
      | right _ => exact .inr ⟨_, _, .unionRight⟩
      | view _ => exact .inr ⟨_, _, .unionView⟩
  | chooseLeft hv =>
      cases intersection_canonical hv with
      | both _ => exact .inr ⟨_, _, .chooseLeft⟩
      | view _ => exact .inr ⟨_, _, .chooseLeftView⟩
  | chooseRight hv =>
      cases intersection_canonical hv with
      | both _ => exact .inr ⟨_, _, .chooseRight⟩
      | view _ => exact .inr ⟨_, _, .chooseRightView⟩
  | absurd hv => exact False.elim (bottom_empty hv)
  | scope hm =>
      rcases closed_progress hm with terminal | ⟨e, n, step⟩
      · cases terminal with
        | returned _ => exact .inr ⟨_, _, .scopeReturn⟩
        | requested _ _ _ => exact .inr ⟨_, _, .scopeRequest⟩
        | failed _ => exact .inr ⟨_, _, .scopeFail⟩
      · exact .inr ⟨e, _, .scope step⟩
  | expose hm =>
      rcases closed_progress hm with terminal | ⟨e, n, step⟩
      · cases terminal with
        | returned _ => exact .inr ⟨_, _, .exposeReturn⟩
        | requested _ _ _ => exact .inr ⟨_, _, .exposeRequest⟩
        | failed _ => exact .inr ⟨_, _, .exposeFail⟩
      · exact .inr ⟨e, _, .expose step⟩
  | dynamicCall hf ha =>
      cases callable_canonical hf with
      | lambda _ _ _ _ _ _ _ => exact .inr ⟨_, _, .callLambda⟩
      | wrap _ => exact .inr ⟨_, _, .callWrap⟩
      | view _ => exact .inr ⟨_, _, .callView⟩
  | handle hh hm =>
      rcases closed_progress hm with terminal | ⟨e, n, step⟩
      · cases terminal with
        | returned _ => exact .inr ⟨_, _, .handleReturn⟩
        | requested _ _ _ => exact .inr ⟨_, _, .handleRequest⟩
        | failed _ => exact .inr ⟨_, _, .handleFail⟩
      · exact .inr ⟨e, _, .handle step⟩
  | tryValue hh hv hs =>
      cases hs with
      | nil => exact .inr ⟨_, _, .valueEmpty⟩
      | cons _ _ => exact .inr ⟨_, _, .valueCons⟩
  | waitValue hh hv hs hm =>
      rcases closed_progress hm with terminal | ⟨e, n, step⟩
      · cases terminal with
        | returned v =>
            cases hm with
            | ret hv =>
                cases union_canonical hv with
                | left _ => exact .inr ⟨_, _, .valueNo⟩
                | right _ => exact .inr ⟨_, _, .valueYes⟩
                | view _ => exact .inr ⟨_, _, .valueView⟩
        | requested _ _ _ => exact .inr ⟨_, _, .valueRequest⟩
        | failed _ => exact .inr ⟨_, _, .valueFail⟩
      · exact .inr ⟨e, _, .valueWait step⟩
  | tryOperation hh hp hk hs => exact operation_trials_progress _ _ _ _ _
  | waitOperation hh hp hk hs hm =>
      rcases closed_progress hm with terminal | ⟨e, n, step⟩
      · cases terminal with
        | returned v =>
            cases hm with
            | ret hv =>
                cases union_canonical hv with
                | left _ => exact .inr ⟨_, _, .operationNo⟩
                | right _ => exact .inr ⟨_, _, .operationYes⟩
                | view _ => exact .inr ⟨_, _, .operationView⟩
        | requested _ _ _ => exact .inr ⟨_, _, .operationRequest⟩
        | failed _ => exact .inr ⟨_, _, .operationFail⟩
      · exact .inr ⟨e, _, .operationWait step⟩

inductive Prefix : Comp → List Event → Comp → Prop where
  | refl (m : Comp) : Prefix m [] m
  | cons : Step m e n → Prefix n events last → Prefix m (e :: events) last

theorem prefix_preservation (trace : Prefix m events n) (h : CompTyped env m a) :
    CompTyped env n a := by
  induction trace generalizing env a with
  | refl => exact h
  | cons step _ ih => exact ih (preservation step h)

/-- All raw finite internal prefixes, including arbitrary actual attempt code. -/
theorem finite_prefix_safety (h : CompTyped emptyContext m a) (trace : Prefix m events n) :
    CompTyped emptyContext n a ∧ CanProgress n := by
  have hn := prefix_preservation trace h
  exact ⟨hn, closed_progress hn⟩

theorem embedded_program_safety (h : HigherOrder.CompTyped emptyContext m a)
    (trace : Prefix (embedComp m) events n) : CompTyped emptyContext n a ∧ CanProgress n :=
  finite_prefix_safety (embedComp_typed h) trace

/-- No linear-use premise: every independently typed response can be substituted
into the same saved code, which is not consumed or modified. -/
theorem resume_typed (hk : CompTyped (extend env q) k a) (hv : ValueTyped env v q) :
    CompTyped env (substComp (single v) k) a := substitute_top hk hv

theorem many_responses_typed (hk : CompTyped (extend env q) k a)
    (responses : List Value) (typed : ∀ v, v ∈ responses → ValueTyped env v q) :
    ∀ v, v ∈ responses → CompTyped env (substComp (single v) k) a :=
  fun v member => resume_typed hk (typed v member)

/-! Distinguishing applications of the universal candidate proofs. -/

def unitType : Ty := .base .unit
def boolType : Ty := .base .bool
def unitOperation : OperationInstance := ⟨20, [], unitType, unitType⟩
def nestedOperation : OperationInstance := ⟨21, [], unitType, boolType⟩

def noAttempt : Comp := .ret (.inLeft .unit)
def yesAttempt : Comp := .ret (.inRight (.bool true))

/-- The arm actually invokes its shallow continuation (index one), passing
its payload (index zero) through a delayed carrier, before returning Yes. -/
def callingAttempt : Comp :=
  .bind (.dynamicCall (.var 1) (.delay (.ret (.var 0)))) yesAttempt

def selectedHandler : Handler :=
  .mk 70 unitType boolType (.cons yesAttempt .nil)
    (.cons unitOperation true callingAttempt .nil)

theorem selectedHandler_typed : HandlerTyped emptyContext selectedHandler unitType boolType :=
  .mk (.cons (.ret (.inRight .bool)) .nil)
    (.cons (.bind (.dynamicCall (.var rfl) (.delay (.ret (.var rfl))))
      (.ret (.inRight .bool))) .nil)

def selectedProgram : Comp :=
  .handle selectedHandler (.request unitOperation .unit (.ret (.var 0)))

theorem selectedProgram_typed : CompTyped emptyContext selectedProgram boolType :=
  .handle selectedHandler_typed (.request .unit (.ret (.var rfl)))

/-- Full actual execution of the attempt, including a higher-order call to K.
The caller's result is unit, while the enclosing handler's result is bool. -/
theorem selected_execution : ∃ events, Prefix selectedProgram events (.ret (.bool true)) := by
  refine ⟨[.silent, .silent,
    .lambdaEntry ⟨.value, ⟨[], []⟩, unitType, unitType, unitType,
      .ret (.var 0), .mk unitType unitType (.ret (.var 0)) [] [], .delay (.ret .unit)⟩,
    .silent, .silent, .silent, .silent, .silent], ?_⟩
  refine .cons .handleRequest (.cons .operationCons ?_)
  refine .cons (.operationWait (.bind .callLambda)) ?_
  refine .cons (.operationWait (.bind (.bind (.bind .force)))) ?_
  refine .cons (.operationWait (.bind (.bind .bindReturn))) ?_
  refine .cons (.operationWait (.bind .bindReturn)) ?_
  refine .cons (.operationWait .bindReturn) ?_
  exact .cons .operationYes (.refl _)

theorem selected_execution_safe : ∃ events,
    Prefix selectedProgram events (.ret (.bool true)) ∧
    CompTyped emptyContext (.ret (.bool true)) boolType ∧ CanProgress (.ret (.bool true)) := by
  obtain ⟨events, trace⟩ := selected_execution
  exact ⟨events, trace, finite_prefix_safety selectedProgram_typed trace⟩

/-- The original code is the lambda body, with no handler inserted. -/
theorem selected_continuation_is_original (h : Handler) (op : OperationInstance)
    (p : Value) (k body : Comp) :
    attemptOperation h op p k body = substComp
      (pairSubstitution p (.lambda .value ⟨[], []⟩ op.responseType h.input h.input k
        (.mk h.input h.input (.ret (.var 0)) [] []))) body := rfl

def forwardingHandler : Handler := .mk 71 unitType boolType (.cons yesAttempt .nil) .nil

theorem forwardingHandler_typed : HandlerTyped emptyContext forwardingHandler unitType boolType :=
  .mk (.cons (.ret (.inRight .bool)) .nil) .nil

theorem forwarded_execution :
    Prefix (.handle forwardingHandler (.request unitOperation .unit (.ret (.var 0))))
      [.silent, .silent]
      (.request unitOperation .unit
        (forwardedContinuation forwardingHandler (.ret (.var 0)))) :=
  .cons .handleRequest (.cons .operationEmpty (.refl _))

theorem forwarded_execution_safe :
    CompTyped emptyContext (.request unitOperation .unit
      (forwardedContinuation forwardingHandler (.ret (.var 0)))) boolType ∧
    CanProgress (.request unitOperation .unit
      (forwardedContinuation forwardingHandler (.ret (.var 0)))) :=
  finite_prefix_safety
    (.handle forwardingHandler_typed (.request .unit (.ret (.var rfl)))) forwarded_execution

/-- Original K returns unit; the forwarded continuation returns bool. -/
theorem distinct_continuation_types :
    ValueTyped emptyContext (continuationValue unitType unitType (.ret (.var 0)))
      (.callable unitType unitType) ∧
    CompTyped (extend emptyContext unitType)
      (forwardedContinuation forwardingHandler (.ret (.var 0))) boolType :=
  ⟨continuationValue_typed (.ret (.var rfl)),
    forwardedContinuation_typed forwardingHandler_typed (.ret (.var rfl))⟩

def orderedHandler : Handler :=
  .mk 72 unitType boolType (.cons noAttempt (.cons yesAttempt .nil)) .nil

theorem orderedHandler_typed : HandlerTyped emptyContext orderedHandler unitType boolType :=
  .mk (.cons (.ret (.inLeft .unit)) (.cons (.ret (.inRight .bool)) .nil)) .nil

theorem ordered_value_trials :
    Prefix (.handle orderedHandler (.ret .unit))
      [.silent, .silent, .silent, .silent, .silent] (.ret (.bool true)) :=
  .cons .handleReturn (.cons .valueCons (.cons .valueNo
    (.cons .valueCons (.cons .valueYes (.refl _)))))

theorem ordered_value_trials_safe : CompTyped emptyContext (.ret (.bool true)) boolType ∧
    CanProgress (.ret (.bool true)) :=
  finite_prefix_safety (.handle orderedHandler_typed (.ret .unit)) ordered_value_trials

/-- The two exhaustion cases have different actual successors. -/
theorem value_exhaustion (h : Handler) (v : Value) :
    Step (.tryValue h v .nil) .silent (.fail .matchFailure) := .valueEmpty

theorem operation_exhaustion (h : Handler) (op : OperationInstance) (p : Value) (k : Comp) :
    Step (.tryOperation h op p k .nil) .silent
      (.request op p (.handle (renameHandler Nat.succ h) k)) := .operationEmpty

/-- Same payload/response types do not suffice to select a different operation. -/
def unrelatedOperation : OperationInstance := ⟨200, [], unitType, unitType⟩

theorem wrong_identity_skipped (h : Handler) (p : Value) (k body : Comp) (rest : OperationArms) :
    Step (.tryOperation h unitOperation p k (.cons unrelatedOperation true body rest)) .silent
      (.tryOperation h unitOperation p k rest) := by
  apply Step.operationSkip
  apply Or.inl
  intro equal
  have impossible : (200 : Nat) = 20 := congrArg OperationInstance.operation equal
  cases impossible

/-- Ordered type arguments are part of the compared instance too. -/
def otherArgumentsOperation : OperationInstance := ⟨20, [boolType], unitType, unitType⟩

theorem wrong_arguments_skipped (h : Handler) (p : Value) (k body : Comp) (rest : OperationArms) :
    Step (.tryOperation h unitOperation p k (.cons otherArgumentsOperation true body rest)) .silent
      (.tryOperation h unitOperation p k rest) := by
  apply Step.operationSkip
  apply Or.inl
  intro equal
  have impossible : [boolType] = ([] : List Ty) := congrArg OperationInstance.typeArguments equal
  cases impossible

/-- Explicit permission data affects selection only; the typing premise for
this arm remains present even when eligibility is false. -/
theorem ineligible_skipped (h : Handler) (op : OperationInstance) (p : Value)
    (k body : Comp) (rest : OperationArms) :
    Step (.tryOperation h op p k (.cons op false body rest)) .silent
      (.tryOperation h op p k rest) := .operationSkip (.inr rfl)

def nestedWait : Comp :=
  .waitOperation forwardingHandler unitOperation .unit (.ret (.var 0)) .nil
    (.request nestedOperation .unit noAttempt)

theorem nestedWait_typed : CompTyped emptyContext nestedWait boolType :=
  .waitOperation forwardingHandler_typed .unit (.ret (.var rfl)) .nil
    (.request .unit (.ret (.inLeft .unit)))

def nestedRestoration : Comp :=
  .waitOperation (renameHandler Nat.succ forwardingHandler) unitOperation
    (renameValue Nat.succ .unit) (renameComp (Original.up Nat.succ) (.ret (.var 0)))
    (renameOperationArms Nat.succ .nil) noAttempt

theorem nested_request_restores_pending_wait :
    Step nestedWait .silent (.request nestedOperation .unit nestedRestoration) := .operationRequest

theorem nested_request_restoration_typed :
    CompTyped emptyContext (.request nestedOperation .unit nestedRestoration) boolType :=
  preservation nested_request_restores_pending_wait nestedWait_typed

theorem nested_response_restoration_typed (response : Value)
    (hr : ValueTyped emptyContext response boolType) :
    CompTyped emptyContext (substComp (single response) nestedRestoration) boolType := by
  have typed := nested_request_restoration_typed
  cases typed with
  | request _ hk => exact resume_typed hk hr

/-- A completed trial event remains in the trace before No advances the
ordered plan. No rule restores a pre-attempt world or replays earlier code. -/
theorem no_after_event (h : Handler) (op : OperationInstance) (p : Value)
    (k : Comp) (rest : OperationArms) :
    Prefix (.waitOperation h op p k rest (.scope 37 noAttempt))
      [.leaveScope 37, .silent] (.tryOperation h op p k rest) :=
  .cons (.operationWait .scopeReturn) (.cons .operationNo (.refl _))

/-- Nested extended forms under both lambda and adapter binders. The result
consumer is in the lambda's outer context; it is not under its parameter. -/
def nestedLambda : Value :=
  .lambda .value ⟨[], []⟩ unitType boolType boolType
    (.handle forwardingHandler (.ret (.var 0)))
    (.mk boolType boolType
      (.handle (.mk 73 boolType boolType (.cons (.ret (.inRight (.var 0))) .nil) .nil)
        (.ret (.var 0))) [] [])

theorem nestedLambda_typed : ValueTyped emptyContext nestedLambda (.callable unitType boolType) :=
  .lambdaValue
    (.handle (.mk (.cons (.ret (.inRight .bool)) .nil) .nil) (.ret (.var rfl)))
    (.mk (.handle (.mk (.cons (.ret (.inRight (.var rfl))) .nil) .nil) (.ret (.var rfl))))

theorem nested_lambda_call_safe
    (trace : Prefix (.dynamicCall nestedLambda (.delay (.ret .unit))) events n) :
    CompTyped emptyContext n boolType ∧ CanProgress n :=
  finite_prefix_safety (.dynamicCall nestedLambda_typed (.delay (.ret .unit))) trace

end YulangClosure.HigherOrder.Handler

# Higher-order shallow handlers: actual code and value safety candidate

Status: candidate mathematics, UNCHECKED and UNREVIEWED at author freeze.
Contract: HANDLER-RECURSIVE-RHS-THEORY-20261025/r1, outcome A.
Author: `/root/higher_order_handler_astra_r1`; requested Astra/medium;
observed model and effort UNKNOWN. No coauthors or descendants at this freeze.
No production, source correspondence, permission, inference or full-paper closure.

The parent is HO-SHALLOW-HANDLER-1, paper lines 399–456 and the local
handler/resume preservation lemma at 1069–1088. The execution theorem at
1139–1159 retains its original full syntax, graph, external-response, metadata
and arbitrary finite-prefix quantifiers. This packet supplies a candidate for
the entire accepted HigherOrder value/computation/adapter grammar, recursively
extended with handlers, ordered trials and waits. Omitted paper forms remain
outside this representation and OPEN at the parent, without changing its scope.

## Construction and application

`HigherOrderHandlerSyntax.lean` defines mutually recursive Value, Comp, Adapter,
Handler, ValueArms and OperationArms, then separate extrinsic typing judgments.
Every accepted HigherOrder constructor is copied structurally, with the same
literal payloads, modes, type annotations, operation instances, receipt data,
views and adapter path correspondence metadata. The full embedding recurses
under lambda bodies, result consumers, adapter inputs, request continuations,
binds and case branches. `embedValue_typed`, `embedComp_typed` and
`embedAdapter_typed` preserve every old typing derivation in its original context.
This is a typing embedding, not a claimed operational equivalence with the old
core's suspended-context terminal classification.

Handlers, trials and waits can occur anywhere Comp can occur, including inside
lambda/delay/adapter code. Value-arm bodies bind the returned value at index 0.
Operation-arm bodies bind payload at index 0 and K at index 1. K is concretely
encoded as a value-entry lambda, with its response binder, original code body,
and an identity result adapter. Its type is Callable(Q,A); invocation uses the
accepted delayed argument carrier convention. No assumed callable function,
opaque code label, BodyLaws or safe-attempt oracle occurs in the construction.

The six-sort renaming and substitution functions traverse all these forms.
Operation arm bodies lift twice; request continuations lift once; lambda result
consumers remain outside the lambda parameter binder. Mutual typing-preservation
proofs for renaming/substitution are supplied. `substitute_pair` closes the
payload and K simultaneously, and `attemptOperation_typed` applies it to actual
arm code. This directly supplies the local attempt premise in the parent lemma.

`HigherOrderHandlerSafety.lean` gives independent raw Step rules. A rule never
contains typing, preservation or safety as a premise. Matching compares equality
of the full OperationInstance: operation identity, ordered type arguments,
payload type and response type. Structural DecidableEq instances are derived
locally for Ty and OperationInstance; no classical equality oracle is invoked.
All arms must type-check regardless of their raw Boolean eligibility flags.
The permission meaning of these flags is not asserted.

Selection substitutes the original K into actual attempt code and puts only a
wait frame around that code. The selected handler is absent during the attempt.
No advances to the remaining arms, and Yes returns the result. Value exhaustion
produces MatchFailure; operation exhaustion forwards the same instance and
payload with `forwardedContinuation h k = handle (renameHandler succ h) k`.
This separate construction has response-to-output typing; it is not the K sent
to an arm. Request propagation under bind shifts only the ambient variables of
the bind body, preserving its own result binder.

A request inside a wait is propagated with the wait in its response binder.
The original handler, payload and remaining arms are shifted once, while the
original K is shifted under its own response binder. The pending original
instance is unchanged. Thus responding to the nested request re-enters the
pending attempt, retaining the original request and plan. Effects are not
intercepted by the removed selected handler, and no transition rewinds prior
execution. `no_after_event` retains the prior event in the prefix before No.
This is a syntactic/event-order fact, not a world-state or effect-hygiene proof.

`preservation` covers every raw step, including all base and handler transitions.
`closed_progress` covers every closed typed extended computation and gives only
Ret, Request, Fail or an actual next step. A request/failure below an evaluation
frame must propagate; it is not classified as an arbitrary suspended term.
`prefix_preservation` and `finite_prefix_safety` apply these results to every
finite raw internal prefix. `resume_typed` and `many_responses_typed` retain each
independently typed response and do not consume or modify saved K. They do not
claim the accepted old interaction arena already represents the new grammar.

Concrete applications include:

- `selected_execution`: a complete raw trace from a unit-input/bool-output
  handler through an arm that actually calls the original unit-to-unit K.
- `forwarded_execution_safe` and `distinct_continuation_types`: forwarding
  produces a unit-to-bool continuation, distinguished from selected K.
- `ordered_value_trials_safe`: a No arm followed by a Yes arm in source order.
- `wrong_identity_skipped`, `wrong_arguments_skipped`, `ineligible_skipped`:
  exact-instance/Boolean selection cases with no weakened matching relation.
- `nested_request_restoration_typed` and
  `nested_response_restoration_typed`: actual request-through-wait followed by
  any independently typed nested response.
- `nestedLambda_typed` and `nested_lambda_call_safe`: extended forms inside
  both lambda and result-adapter binders, applied back to finite-prefix safety.

## Source/native boundary and precise remaining obligations

Read-only inspection of frozen `runtime/machine.rs` and `continuation.rs`
provides owner locators, not a source/native simulation theorem.

`Machine::propagate_request` (machine.rs:2081 onward) compares native declaration
identities, requires local grants outside its closed primitive case, checks a
restricted operation signature/payload domain, captures K before popping the
selected `Frame::CatchReturn`, and then evaluates selected arm code outside that
handler. This agrees with the selected-versus-forwarded distinction at a control
shape level, but does not construct this candidate's fully typed attempt plans.
The current routine does not supply general effectful No/Yes trial code and
pending-wait restoration. Its native payload/response restrictions are not used
to restrict the theorem's accepted HigherOrder domain.

`Frame::CatchReturn` (machine.rs:1098–1136) selects the first value pattern and
returns the received value when no value arm exists. The paper's empty value
trial instead yields MatchFailure. This observed difference blocks identifying
this candidate with that native path without an explicit semantic/source bridge;
it is not authority to change the runtime or revise the paper.

`SavedFrame::HandlerBoundary` (machine.rs:2306 onward),
`TemplateNode::ForwardHandler` (continuation.rs:34), and its replay case
(machine.rs:1989–2008) retain handler/environment/owner and allocate a fresh
handler occurrence on replay. The candidate retains handler identity and code
but does not model this activation/owner freshening or prove the native replay
correspondence. Preserving a numeric identity is not proof of freshening.

Luna/source intake owns the following remaining premises:

1. HO-HANDLER-SOURCE-1: source Catch arm elaboration must produce typed ordered
   attempt bodies, simultaneous payload/K binders and the same full operation
   instance. Falsifier: a reachable body using the wrong index/instance, an
   untyped disabled arm, or loss of an accepted higher-order constructor.
2. HO-HANDLER-NATIVE-WAIT-1: a future authorized native correspondence packet
   must map actual pending waits and request propagation to `Step.operationRequest`
   and `Step.valueRequest`. Falsifier: a nested response drops the remaining arms,
   original payload/K, or reinstalls the selected handler around attempt effects.
3. HO-HANDLER-VALUE-EMPTY-1: adjudicate the paper/native no-value-arm discrepancy
   at `Frame::CatchReturn`; no code change is authorized by this packet.
4. HO-METADATA-ADEQUACY-1: actual eligibility/permissions, owner/activation
   freshening, receipt/view behavior and rigid polymorphic elaboration remain
   separate semantic/source obligations. Every total Boolean choice is covered
   only as raw selection data in this value-typing projection.
5. Full-paper safety: graph extension, omitted tuple/record/variant/nominal/mu/
   evidence/type-abstraction/primitive/mapop/rec/template forms, and the combined
   new handler grammar with arbitrary saved external interactions remain OPEN.
   Existing F1/FK1 and Simple-sub A/B obligations are unaffected.

No production implementation TODO is authorized. The minimal next source packet
would be a read-only source-to-raw binder/instance/wait mapping using these owners
and falsifiers; any prototype must first receive a new explicit Luna lease.

## Reuse, checking and resources

Accepted HigherOrderSyntax supplies Ty and all metadata. The accepted
HigherOrderSubstitution, Entry and Safety proofs supply the structural method
and base cases, which are reproved over the extended syntax rather than applied
outside their old domain. HigherOrderInteraction is read for its independent
response/immutable-saved-code boundary; its theorem is not claimed for handlers.
No historical failure, literal-only theorem or assumed transition is promoted
into a source theorem. No Simple-sub mechanism, compiler behavior or expectation
was changed.

Author checks: NOT_RUN (Lean, build, tests and checkers prohibited by the packet).
Textual reads and SHA-256 hashing only; primary owns serialized elaboration,
public-signature and strict transitive-axiom inspection, followed by fresh
nonauthor review. Required axiom closure is a subset of {propext, Quot.sound}.
This note is not certification of compilation or proof acceptance.

Only the two leased Lean files, this note and the one leased inbox are written.
No scratch files, background processes, child workers, Git operations, external
contacts or edits to accepted modules. The frozen inbox records the final hashes,
time and STOP receipt; there is no implied continuation while waiting for intake.

## Primary coauthorship and candidate freeze

Primary acknowledged the author's actual STOP and took over the two source files
and this note at 07:14:40.175763 UTC. Primary coauthorship repairs: six mutual
proof application layouts and an ordinary comment before mutual; reserved local
binder prefix renamed trace; explicit Nat.succ weakening in the two response
propagation cases; concrete eight-event witness for the selected-continuation
execution. These preserve raw grammar, transitions, types and theorem domains.
The author inbox remains byte-frozen at its original handoff hashes.

Primary has elaborated both modules and queried every named public declaration.
The combined query covers 273 module declarations plus eight primary query
constructions, with eight additional anonymous boundary examples. All successful
query results have transitive axiom closure contained in {propext, Quot.sound}.
The query exercises empty value-arm failure, concrete instance inequality, nested
response restoration, ordered trials, double binder lifting, transparent wrapper
cycle rejection, guarded constructors and alias-cycle rejection. Earlier failed
elaboration/query receipts remain preserved. Final source/note-bound rebuild and
fresh nonauthor review are required before acceptance; their exact receipts and
adjudication belong to the sprint outcome.

observed model/effort UNKNOWN. Primary /root repairs and integrates after author
STOP; the outcome records final authorship and independent review. No descendants.
Production authority: none. The operational paper is a proposal/target; the
2026-10-07 complete-Call definition §1 records permission for legitimate research
definitions, not adoption of this representation as compiler architecture.

The parent RESPONSE-ENCODING-1 / ENV-CALLABLE-1 lacked a callable constructor in
its formal Value sort. The candidate removes that specific representational
obstruction by constructing a new callable type and actual lambda/wrap values.
Every Original.Val/Comp and TypedCall.Value/Comp/Adapter/Function constructor is
mapped structurally. No old term is retained behind an opaque original opcode.
The full parent, native readback and operational safety remain OPEN.

## Syntax and quantifiers

`HigherOrderSyntax.lean` retains every old type constructor, all eight literal
domains and their exact payload representations, variables, delay, injections,
single-child intersection/top values and all seven Original computations. It
adds the existing Call view/scope/expose/request/fail nodes, lambda/wrap values,
and dynamicCall. Request's continuation binds its operation instance's response
type. The type language can place callable types beneath thunk/union/intersection
and in operation instances. The value, computation and adapter syntax is mutually
inductive; all typing judgments are defined afterwards.

Value-entry lambda binds A; computation-entry lambda binds Thunk A. Both retain
receipt, annotated input/body/result types, body and result consumer. Wrap keeps
the input adapter c→a and output adapter b→d around an a→b function. DynamicCall
accepts a thunk carrier. This fixes a research typing interface without asserting
an execution rule or operational equivalence for the new constructor.

`ContextEmbedding old new` quantifies over every old lookup fact. The mutual
Original and TypedCall preservation proofs quantify over arbitrary old terms,
old typing derivations and target contexts satisfying that relation. Closed
Original nodes embed under any target context using the empty lookup relation;
binders use `extend_embedding`. The Function theorem quantifies over every old
FunctionTyped derivation and every target context. No original constructor,
source-domain restriction or independent continuation quantifier is discarded.
This is one-way typing preservation, not reflection or full conservativity.

## Metadata boundary

Paths retain component lists, port kinds and translated endpoint types;
occurrences retain identities and paths. Operation instances retain operation
identity, ordered type arguments and both payload/response types. Receipt slots
and profiles retain order, identity and typed paths. Adapter metadata retains
all path correspondences and captured occurrences. Interface-port metadata also
has a structural map.

PathRule is a Prop in the accepted input. `embedPathRule` translates its proof
into a new Prop proof. It does not eliminate that proof into a data-valued map
identity. In particular the old permissive adapterMap rule remains permissive;
this work cannot prove that a mappingIdentity absent from runtime data can be
reconstructed. Syntax is **typing-proof-free**, not entirely proof-free. The old
Adapter.typed field is omitted from syntax and consumed solely to construct the
new extrinsic AdapterTyped derivation. The retained PathRule metadata neither
contains a typing judgment nor creates a typing-definition cycle.

## Parent application

`embedFunction_typed` constructs a ValueTyped callable from an old FunctionTyped
proof. `function_as_argument` and `call_with_function_argument` use it in the
actual new delayed argument and dynamicCall constructors.
`request_callable_response` constructs a request that binds and returns a
callable-typed response. `function_cell` pushes the embedded function into the
existing generic NativeClosureEnvironment.Store, proves the actual current cell
equality and supplies its callable typing derivation.

`read_embedding` preserves the exact old selected cell address while mapping the
current store pointwise. `read_embedding_typed` combines that equation with the
accepted `successful_read_typed` theorem. `captured_value_typed` applies the
accepted `realized_substitution_typed` supplier to each represented context index;
`captured_body_typed` applies its actual successful capture and closed-body
construction before embedding. Both keep successful realization and CellsTyped
as explicit original premises. Nothing claims that arbitrary native closures
already satisfy those premises, or that old stores already represent new
callable values. Generic new callable storage and old represented-read transport
are two separate constructions whose native connection is still open.

## Remaining source obligations and reuse

Accepted CoreSyntax typing and CallEnvironmentRealization supply precisely their
existing domains. CoreSubstitution's bind/request lifting is reused through
close_body, without reproving lookup or assuming a new substitution rule. The
NativeClosureEnvironment.Store remains generic; no machine fields change.
Historical literal readback is not extended to callable readback by analogy.
No failure is dismissed by a narrower theorem; no new source restriction,
Simple-sub bypass or production implementation is introduced.

Luna/source intake owns ENV-LAYOUT-1 (resolved free-variable order and binder
indices from source Lambda/Name/Apply), ENV-CELL-VALUE-1 (current native Value
encoding), ENV-GRAPH-1 (recursive cell/closure graphs), ENV-CALLABLE-1's remaining
native body/consumer mapping, and ENV-DISPATCH-1. Relevant native owners remain
machine.rs `Instruction::Lambda`, `Frame::ValueEntry`, `Machine::lookup`,
`Machine::extend`, closure/Callee branches and receiving.rs lambda schema
construction. The primary's disjoint source map gives their complete exact
producer/consumer inventory, including unit/record/default entry cases.
Force, native transitions, new-core substitution/progress/preservation,
whole-trace safety, operation authenticity and original inference A/B remain
OPEN. No F1/FK1 or foreign-continuation theorem is claimed here.

## Intake and checks

No Lean/build/tests/native checks were run by the author. A shell `python`

Only the four exact leased files were created; there are no scratch paths,

import YulangClosure.HigherOrderSubstitution

/-! Full accepted higher-order grammar with graph references and simultaneous
recursive names. Candidate research theory; no native heap interpretation. -/
namespace YulangClosure.HigherOrderGraph
open HigherOrder (Ty Context emptyContext extend ViewOccurrence ReceiptTemplate
  OperationInstance PathCorrespondence)

mutual
  inductive Value (R S : Type) where
    | ref (reference : R)
    | recvar (name : S)
    | var (index : Nat)
    | unit
    | bool (value : Bool)
    | int (value : Int)
    | floatBits (value : UInt64)
    | string (value : String)
    | bytes (value : List UInt8)
    | path (value : List UInt8)
    | char (value : String)
    | delay (body : Comp R S)
    | inLeft (value : Value R S)
    | inRight (value : Value R S)
    | both (value : Value R S)
    | top (value : Value R S)
    | view (value : Value R S) (occurrence : ViewOccurrence)
    | lambda (mode : Original.Mode) (receipt : ReceiptTemplate)
        (argument bodyResult result : Ty) (body : Comp R S) (consumer : Adapter R S)
    | wrap (inner : Value R S) (input output : Adapter R S)
  inductive Comp (R S : Type) where
    | ret (value : Value R S)
    | force (value : Value R S)
    | bind (first body : Comp R S)
    | unionCase (value : Value R S) (left right : Comp R S)
    | chooseLeft (value : Value R S)
    | chooseRight (value : Value R S)
    | absurd (value : Value R S)
    | scope (owner : Nat) (body : Comp R S)
    | expose (effectView resultView : ViewOccurrence) (body : Comp R S)
    | request (op : OperationInstance) (payload : Value R S) (continuation : Comp R S)
    | fail (reason : Original.Failure)
    | dynamicCall (function argument : Value R S)
  inductive Adapter (R S : Type) where
    | mk (input output : Ty) (body : Comp R S)
        (paths : List PathCorrespondence) (views : List ViewOccurrence)
end

mutual
  inductive ValueTyped (xi : R → Ty) (nu : S → Ty) : Context → Value R S → Ty → Prop
    | ref (r) : ValueTyped xi nu env (.ref r) (xi r)
    | recvar (s) : ValueTyped xi nu env (.recvar s) (nu s)
    | var : env i = some a → ValueTyped xi nu env (.var i) a
    | unit : ValueTyped xi nu env .unit (.base .unit)
    | bool : ValueTyped xi nu env (.bool v) (.base .bool)
    | int : ValueTyped xi nu env (.int v) (.base .int)
    | floatBits : ValueTyped xi nu env (.floatBits v) (.base .float)
    | string : ValueTyped xi nu env (.string v) (.base .string)
    | bytes : ValueTyped xi nu env (.bytes v) (.base .bytes)
    | path : ValueTyped xi nu env (.path v) (.base .path)
    | char : ValueTyped xi nu env (.char v) (.base .char)
    | delay : CompTyped xi nu env m a → ValueTyped xi nu env (.delay m) (.thunk a)
    | inLeft : ValueTyped xi nu env v a → ValueTyped xi nu env (.inLeft v) (.union a b)
    | inRight : ValueTyped xi nu env v b → ValueTyped xi nu env (.inRight v) (.union a b)
    | both : ValueTyped xi nu env v a → ValueTyped xi nu env v b →
        ValueTyped xi nu env (.both v) (.intersection a b)
    | top : ValueTyped xi nu env v a → ValueTyped xi nu env (.top v) .top
    | view : ValueTyped xi nu env v a → ValueTyped xi nu env (.view v occurrence) a
    | lambdaValue : CompTyped xi nu (extend env a) body b → AdapterTyped xi nu env consumer b r →
        ValueTyped xi nu env (.lambda .value receipt a b r body consumer) (.callable a r)
    | lambdaComputation : CompTyped xi nu (extend env (.thunk a)) body b → AdapterTyped xi nu env consumer b r →
        ValueTyped xi nu env (.lambda .computation receipt a b r body consumer) (.callable a r)
    | wrap : ValueTyped xi nu env f (.callable a b) → AdapterTyped xi nu env input c a →
        AdapterTyped xi nu env output b d → ValueTyped xi nu env (.wrap f input output) (.callable c d)
  inductive CompTyped (xi : R → Ty) (nu : S → Ty) : Context → Comp R S → Ty → Prop
    | ret : ValueTyped xi nu env v a → CompTyped xi nu env (.ret v) a
    | force : ValueTyped xi nu env v (.thunk a) → CompTyped xi nu env (.force v) a
    | bind : CompTyped xi nu env m a → CompTyped xi nu (extend env a) n b →
        CompTyped xi nu env (.bind m n) b
    | unionCase : ValueTyped xi nu env v (.union a b) →
        CompTyped xi nu (extend env a) l c → CompTyped xi nu (extend env b) r c →
        CompTyped xi nu env (.unionCase v l r) c
    | chooseLeft : ValueTyped xi nu env v (.intersection a b) → CompTyped xi nu env (.chooseLeft v) a
    | chooseRight : ValueTyped xi nu env v (.intersection a b) → CompTyped xi nu env (.chooseRight v) b
    | absurd : ValueTyped xi nu env v .bottom → CompTyped xi nu env (.absurd v) a
    | scope : CompTyped xi nu env body a → CompTyped xi nu env (.scope owner body) a
    | expose : CompTyped xi nu env body a → CompTyped xi nu env (.expose ev rv body) a
    | request : ValueTyped xi nu env payload op.payloadType →
        CompTyped xi nu (extend env op.responseType) continuation a →
        CompTyped xi nu env (.request op payload continuation) a
    | fail : CompTyped xi nu env (.fail reason) a
    | dynamicCall : ValueTyped xi nu env f (.callable a b) → ValueTyped xi nu env arg (.thunk a) →
        CompTyped xi nu env (.dynamicCall f arg) b
  inductive AdapterTyped (xi : R → Ty) (nu : S → Ty) : Context → Adapter R S → Ty → Ty → Prop where
    | mk : CompTyped xi nu (extend env a) body b →
        AdapterTyped xi nu env (.mk a b body paths views) a b
end

variable {R S T : Type} {xi : R → Ty} {nu : S → Ty}

mutual
  def renameValue (r : Nat → Nat) : Value R S → Value R S
    | .ref r => .ref r
    | .recvar s => .recvar s
    | .var i => .var (r i)
    | .unit => .unit
    | .bool v => .bool v
    | .int v => .int v
    | .floatBits v => .floatBits v
    | .string v => .string v
    | .bytes v => .bytes v
    | .path v => .path v
    | .char v => .char v
    | .delay m => .delay (renameComp r m)
    | .inLeft v => .inLeft (renameValue r v)
    | .inRight v => .inRight (renameValue r v)
    | .both v => .both (renameValue r v)
    | .top v => .top (renameValue r v)
    | .view v o => .view (renameValue r v) o
    | .lambda mode receipt a b c body consumer =>
        .lambda mode receipt a b c (renameComp (Original.up r) body) (renameAdapter r consumer)
    | .wrap f input output => .wrap (renameValue r f) (renameAdapter r input) (renameAdapter r output)
  def renameComp (r : Nat → Nat) : Comp R S → Comp R S
    | .ret v => .ret (renameValue r v)
    | .force v => .force (renameValue r v)
    | .chooseLeft v => .chooseLeft (renameValue r v)
    | .chooseRight v => .chooseRight (renameValue r v)
    | .absurd v => .absurd (renameValue r v)
    | .bind m n => .bind (renameComp r m) (renameComp (Original.up r) n)
    | .unionCase v l right => .unionCase (renameValue r v) (renameComp (Original.up r) l) (renameComp (Original.up r) right)
    | .scope owner body => .scope owner (renameComp r body)
    | .expose ev rv body => .expose ev rv (renameComp r body)
    | .request op v k => .request op (renameValue r v) (renameComp (Original.up r) k)
    | .fail reason => .fail reason
    | .dynamicCall f a => .dynamicCall (renameValue r f) (renameValue r a)
  def renameAdapter (r : Nat → Nat) : Adapter R S → Adapter R S
    | .mk a b body paths views => .mk a b (renameComp (Original.up r) body) paths views
end

def lift (s : Nat → Value R S) : Nat → Value R S
  | 0 => .var 0
  | n+1 => renameValue Nat.succ (s n)

mutual
  def substValue (s : Nat → Value R S) : Value R S → Value R S
    | .ref r => .ref r
    | .recvar s => .recvar s
    | .var i => s i
    | .unit => .unit
    | .bool v => .bool v
    | .int v => .int v
    | .floatBits v => .floatBits v
    | .string v => .string v
    | .bytes v => .bytes v
    | .path v => .path v
    | .char v => .char v
    | .delay m => .delay (substComp s m)
    | .inLeft v => .inLeft (substValue s v)
    | .inRight v => .inRight (substValue s v)
    | .both v => .both (substValue s v)
    | .top v => .top (substValue s v)
    | .view v o => .view (substValue s v) o
    | .lambda mode receipt a b c body consumer =>
        .lambda mode receipt a b c (substComp (lift s) body) (substAdapter s consumer)
    | .wrap f input output => .wrap (substValue s f) (substAdapter s input) (substAdapter s output)
  def substComp (s : Nat → Value R S) : Comp R S → Comp R S
    | .ret v => .ret (substValue s v)
    | .force v => .force (substValue s v)
    | .chooseLeft v => .chooseLeft (substValue s v)
    | .chooseRight v => .chooseRight (substValue s v)
    | .absurd v => .absurd (substValue s v)
    | .bind m n => .bind (substComp s m) (substComp (lift s) n)
    | .unionCase v l r => .unionCase (substValue s v) (substComp (lift s) l) (substComp (lift s) r)
    | .scope owner body => .scope owner (substComp s body)
    | .expose ev rv body => .expose ev rv (substComp s body)
    | .request op v k => .request op (substValue s v) (substComp (lift s) k)
    | .fail reason => .fail reason
    | .dynamicCall f a => .dynamicCall (substValue s f) (substValue s a)
  def substAdapter (s : Nat → Value R S) : Adapter R S → Adapter R S
    | .mk a b body paths views => .mk a b (substComp (lift s) body) paths views
end

def RenamingTyped (env target : Context) (r : Nat → Nat) : Prop :=
  ∀ i a, env i = some a → target (r i) = some a

theorem up_typed (h : RenamingTyped env target r) (a : Ty) :
    RenamingTyped (extend env a) (extend target a) (Original.up r) := by
  intro i b hi
  cases i with
  | zero => exact hi
  | succ i => exact h i b hi

mutual
  theorem renameValue_typed (h : ValueTyped xi nu env v a) (ht : RenamingTyped env target r) :
      ValueTyped xi nu target (renameValue r v) a := by
    cases h with
    | ref r => exact .ref r
    | recvar s => exact .recvar s
    | var h => exact .var (ht _ _ h)
    | unit => exact .unit
    | bool => exact .bool
    | int => exact .int
    | floatBits => exact .floatBits
    | string => exact .string
    | bytes => exact .bytes
    | path => exact .path
    | char => exact .char
    | delay h => exact .delay (renameComp_typed h ht)
    | inLeft h => exact .inLeft (renameValue_typed h ht)
    | inRight h => exact .inRight (renameValue_typed h ht)
    | top h => exact .top (renameValue_typed h ht)
    | view h => exact .view (renameValue_typed h ht)
    | both h k => exact .both (renameValue_typed h ht) (renameValue_typed k ht)
    | lambdaValue h k => exact .lambdaValue (renameComp_typed h (up_typed ht _)) (renameAdapter_typed k ht)
    | lambdaComputation h k => exact .lambdaComputation (renameComp_typed h (up_typed ht _)) (renameAdapter_typed k ht)
    | wrap h i o => exact .wrap (renameValue_typed h ht) (renameAdapter_typed i ht) (renameAdapter_typed o ht)
  theorem renameComp_typed (h : CompTyped xi nu env m a) (ht : RenamingTyped env target r) :
      CompTyped xi nu target (renameComp r m) a := by
    cases h with
    | ret h => exact .ret (renameValue_typed h ht)
    | force h => exact .force (renameValue_typed h ht)
    | chooseLeft h => exact .chooseLeft (renameValue_typed h ht)
    | chooseRight h => exact .chooseRight (renameValue_typed h ht)
    | absurd h => exact .absurd (renameValue_typed h ht)
    | bind h k => exact .bind (renameComp_typed h ht) (renameComp_typed k (up_typed ht _))
    | unionCase h l r =>
        exact .unionCase (renameValue_typed h ht)
          (renameComp_typed l (up_typed ht _)) (renameComp_typed r (up_typed ht _))
    | scope h => exact .scope (renameComp_typed h ht)
    | expose h => exact .expose (renameComp_typed h ht)
    | request h k => exact .request (renameValue_typed h ht) (renameComp_typed k (up_typed ht _))
    | fail => exact .fail
    | dynamicCall h k => exact .dynamicCall (renameValue_typed h ht) (renameValue_typed k ht)
  theorem renameAdapter_typed (h : AdapterTyped xi nu env adapter a b) (ht : RenamingTyped env target r) :
      AdapterTyped xi nu target (renameAdapter r adapter) a b := by
    cases h with
    | mk h => exact .mk (renameComp_typed h (up_typed ht _))
end

def SubstitutionTyped (xi : R → Ty) (nu : S → Ty) (env target : Context) (s : Nat → Value R S) : Prop :=
  ∀ i a, env i = some a → ValueTyped xi nu target (s i) a

theorem lift_typed (h : SubstitutionTyped xi nu env target s) (a : Ty) :
    SubstitutionTyped xi nu (extend env a) (extend target a) (lift s) := by
  intro i b hi
  cases i with
  | zero =>
      simp only [extend, Option.some.injEq] at hi
      subst b
      exact .var rfl
  | succ i => exact renameValue_typed (h i b hi) (fun _ _ h => h)

mutual
  theorem substValue_typed (h : ValueTyped xi nu env v a) (ht : SubstitutionTyped xi nu env target s) :
      ValueTyped xi nu target (substValue s v) a := by
    cases h with
    | ref r => exact .ref r
    | recvar s => exact .recvar s
    | var h => exact ht _ _ h
    | unit => exact .unit
    | bool => exact .bool
    | int => exact .int
    | floatBits => exact .floatBits
    | string => exact .string
    | bytes => exact .bytes
    | path => exact .path
    | char => exact .char
    | delay h => exact .delay (substComp_typed h ht)
    | inLeft h => exact .inLeft (substValue_typed h ht)
    | inRight h => exact .inRight (substValue_typed h ht)
    | top h => exact .top (substValue_typed h ht)
    | view h => exact .view (substValue_typed h ht)
    | both h k => exact .both (substValue_typed h ht) (substValue_typed k ht)
    | lambdaValue h k => exact .lambdaValue (substComp_typed h (lift_typed ht _)) (substAdapter_typed k ht)
    | lambdaComputation h k => exact .lambdaComputation (substComp_typed h (lift_typed ht _)) (substAdapter_typed k ht)
    | wrap h i o => exact .wrap (substValue_typed h ht) (substAdapter_typed i ht) (substAdapter_typed o ht)
  theorem substComp_typed (h : CompTyped xi nu env m a) (ht : SubstitutionTyped xi nu env target s) :
      CompTyped xi nu target (substComp s m) a := by
    cases h with
    | ret h => exact .ret (substValue_typed h ht)
    | force h => exact .force (substValue_typed h ht)
    | chooseLeft h => exact .chooseLeft (substValue_typed h ht)
    | chooseRight h => exact .chooseRight (substValue_typed h ht)
    | absurd h => exact .absurd (substValue_typed h ht)
    | bind h k => exact .bind (substComp_typed h ht) (substComp_typed k (lift_typed ht _))
    | unionCase h l r =>
        exact .unionCase (substValue_typed h ht)
          (substComp_typed l (lift_typed ht _)) (substComp_typed r (lift_typed ht _))
    | scope h => exact .scope (substComp_typed h ht)
    | expose h => exact .expose (substComp_typed h ht)
    | request h k => exact .request (substValue_typed h ht) (substComp_typed k (lift_typed ht _))
    | fail => exact .fail
    | dynamicCall h k => exact .dynamicCall (substValue_typed h ht) (substValue_typed k ht)
  theorem substAdapter_typed (h : AdapterTyped xi nu env adapter a b) (ht : SubstitutionTyped xi nu env target s) :
      AdapterTyped xi nu target (substAdapter s adapter) a b := by
    cases h with
    | mk h => exact .mk (substComp_typed h (lift_typed ht _))
end


/- Structural embedding retains every accepted constructor and metadata field. -/
mutual
  def embedValue : HigherOrder.Value → Value R S
    | .var i => .var i
    | .unit => .unit
    | .bool v => .bool v
    | .int v => .int v
    | .floatBits v => .floatBits v
    | .string v => .string v
    | .bytes v => .bytes v
    | .path v => .path v
    | .char v => .char v
    | .delay m => .delay (embedComp m)
    | .inLeft v => .inLeft (embedValue v)
    | .inRight v => .inRight (embedValue v)
    | .both v => .both (embedValue v)
    | .top v => .top (embedValue v)
    | .view v o => .view (embedValue v) o
    | .lambda mode receipt a b c body consumer =>
        .lambda mode receipt a b c (embedComp body) (embedAdapter consumer)
    | .wrap f input output => .wrap (embedValue f) (embedAdapter input) (embedAdapter output)
  def embedComp : HigherOrder.Comp → Comp R S
    | .ret v => .ret (embedValue v)
    | .force v => .force (embedValue v)
    | .chooseLeft v => .chooseLeft (embedValue v)
    | .chooseRight v => .chooseRight (embedValue v)
    | .absurd v => .absurd (embedValue v)
    | .bind m n => .bind (embedComp m) (embedComp n)
    | .unionCase v l right => .unionCase (embedValue v) (embedComp l) (embedComp right)
    | .scope owner body => .scope owner (embedComp body)
    | .expose ev rv body => .expose ev rv (embedComp body)
    | .request op v k => .request op (embedValue v) (embedComp k)
    | .fail reason => .fail reason
    | .dynamicCall f a => .dynamicCall (embedValue f) (embedValue a)
  def embedAdapter : HigherOrder.Adapter → Adapter R S
    | .mk a b body paths views => .mk a b (embedComp body) paths views
end

mutual
  theorem embedValue_typed (h : HigherOrder.ValueTyped env v a) :
      ValueTyped xi nu env (embedValue v) a := by
    cases h with
    | var h => exact .var h
    | unit => exact .unit
    | bool => exact .bool
    | int => exact .int
    | floatBits => exact .floatBits
    | string => exact .string
    | bytes => exact .bytes
    | path => exact .path
    | char => exact .char
    | delay h => exact .delay (embedComp_typed h)
    | inLeft h => exact .inLeft (embedValue_typed h)
    | inRight h => exact .inRight (embedValue_typed h)
    | top h => exact .top (embedValue_typed h)
    | view h => exact .view (embedValue_typed h)
    | both h k => exact .both (embedValue_typed h) (embedValue_typed k)
    | lambdaValue h k => exact .lambdaValue (embedComp_typed h) (embedAdapter_typed k)
    | lambdaComputation h k => exact .lambdaComputation (embedComp_typed h) (embedAdapter_typed k)
    | wrap h i o => exact .wrap (embedValue_typed h) (embedAdapter_typed i) (embedAdapter_typed o)
  theorem embedComp_typed (h : HigherOrder.CompTyped env m a) :
      CompTyped xi nu env (embedComp m) a := by
    cases h with
    | ret h => exact .ret (embedValue_typed h)
    | force h => exact .force (embedValue_typed h)
    | chooseLeft h => exact .chooseLeft (embedValue_typed h)
    | chooseRight h => exact .chooseRight (embedValue_typed h)
    | absurd h => exact .absurd (embedValue_typed h)
    | bind h k => exact .bind (embedComp_typed h) (embedComp_typed k)
    | unionCase h l r =>
        exact .unionCase (embedValue_typed h)
          (embedComp_typed l) (embedComp_typed r)
    | scope h => exact .scope (embedComp_typed h)
    | expose h => exact .expose (embedComp_typed h)
    | request h k => exact .request (embedValue_typed h) (embedComp_typed k)
    | fail => exact .fail
    | dynamicCall h k => exact .dynamicCall (embedValue_typed h) (embedValue_typed k)
  theorem embedAdapter_typed (h : HigherOrder.AdapterTyped env adapter a b) :
      AdapterTyped xi nu env (embedAdapter adapter) a b := by
    cases h with
    | mk h => exact .mk (embedComp_typed h)
end

def emptyTy : Empty → Ty := Empty.elim

mutual
  def closeNamesValue (f : R → T) (g : S → T) : Value R S → Value T Empty
    | .ref r => .ref (f r)
    | .recvar s => .ref (g s)
    | .var i => .var i
    | .unit => .unit
    | .bool v => .bool v
    | .int v => .int v
    | .floatBits v => .floatBits v
    | .string v => .string v
    | .bytes v => .bytes v
    | .path v => .path v
    | .char v => .char v
    | .delay m => .delay (closeNamesComp f g m)
    | .inLeft v => .inLeft (closeNamesValue f g v)
    | .inRight v => .inRight (closeNamesValue f g v)
    | .both v => .both (closeNamesValue f g v)
    | .top v => .top (closeNamesValue f g v)
    | .view v o => .view (closeNamesValue f g v) o
    | .lambda mode receipt a b c body consumer =>
        .lambda mode receipt a b c (closeNamesComp f g body) (closeNamesAdapter f g consumer)
    | .wrap inner input output => .wrap (closeNamesValue f g inner) (closeNamesAdapter f g input) (closeNamesAdapter f g output)
  def closeNamesComp (f : R → T) (g : S → T) : Comp R S → Comp T Empty
    | .ret v => .ret (closeNamesValue f g v)
    | .force v => .force (closeNamesValue f g v)
    | .chooseLeft v => .chooseLeft (closeNamesValue f g v)
    | .chooseRight v => .chooseRight (closeNamesValue f g v)
    | .absurd v => .absurd (closeNamesValue f g v)
    | .bind m n => .bind (closeNamesComp f g m) (closeNamesComp f g n)
    | .unionCase v l right => .unionCase (closeNamesValue f g v) (closeNamesComp f g l) (closeNamesComp f g right)
    | .scope owner body => .scope owner (closeNamesComp f g body)
    | .expose ev rv body => .expose ev rv (closeNamesComp f g body)
    | .request op v k => .request op (closeNamesValue f g v) (closeNamesComp f g k)
    | .fail reason => .fail reason
    | .dynamicCall fn a => .dynamicCall (closeNamesValue f g fn) (closeNamesValue f g a)
  def closeNamesAdapter (f : R → T) (g : S → T) : Adapter R S → Adapter T Empty
    | .mk a b body paths views => .mk a b (closeNamesComp f g body) paths views
end

variable {tau : T → Ty}

mutual
  theorem closeNamesValue_typed (h : ValueTyped xi nu env v a) (f : R → T) (g : S → T)
      (hf : ∀ r, tau (f r) = xi r) (hg : ∀ s, tau (g s) = nu s) :
      ValueTyped tau emptyTy env (closeNamesValue f g v) a := by
    cases h with
    | ref r =>
        simpa only [closeNamesValue, hf] using (ValueTyped.ref (xi := tau) (nu := emptyTy) (env := env) (f r))
    | recvar r =>
        simpa only [closeNamesValue, hg] using (ValueTyped.ref (xi := tau) (nu := emptyTy) (env := env) (g r))
    | var h => exact .var h
    | unit => exact .unit
    | bool => exact .bool
    | int => exact .int
    | floatBits => exact .floatBits
    | string => exact .string
    | bytes => exact .bytes
    | path => exact .path
    | char => exact .char
    | delay h => exact .delay (closeNamesComp_typed h f g hf hg)
    | inLeft h => exact .inLeft (closeNamesValue_typed h f g hf hg)
    | inRight h => exact .inRight (closeNamesValue_typed h f g hf hg)
    | top h => exact .top (closeNamesValue_typed h f g hf hg)
    | view h => exact .view (closeNamesValue_typed h f g hf hg)
    | both h k => exact .both (closeNamesValue_typed h f g hf hg) (closeNamesValue_typed k f g hf hg)
    | lambdaValue h k => exact .lambdaValue (closeNamesComp_typed h f g hf hg) (closeNamesAdapter_typed k f g hf hg)
    | lambdaComputation h k => exact .lambdaComputation (closeNamesComp_typed h f g hf hg) (closeNamesAdapter_typed k f g hf hg)
    | wrap h i o => exact .wrap (closeNamesValue_typed h f g hf hg) (closeNamesAdapter_typed i f g hf hg) (closeNamesAdapter_typed o f g hf hg)
  theorem closeNamesComp_typed (h : CompTyped xi nu env m a) (f : R → T) (g : S → T)
      (hf : ∀ r, tau (f r) = xi r) (hg : ∀ s, tau (g s) = nu s) :
      CompTyped tau emptyTy env (closeNamesComp f g m) a := by
    cases h with
    | ret h => exact .ret (closeNamesValue_typed h f g hf hg)
    | force h => exact .force (closeNamesValue_typed h f g hf hg)
    | chooseLeft h => exact .chooseLeft (closeNamesValue_typed h f g hf hg)
    | chooseRight h => exact .chooseRight (closeNamesValue_typed h f g hf hg)
    | absurd h => exact .absurd (closeNamesValue_typed h f g hf hg)
    | bind h k => exact .bind (closeNamesComp_typed h f g hf hg) (closeNamesComp_typed k f g hf hg)
    | unionCase h l r =>
        exact .unionCase (closeNamesValue_typed h f g hf hg)
          (closeNamesComp_typed l f g hf hg) (closeNamesComp_typed r f g hf hg)
    | scope h => exact .scope (closeNamesComp_typed h f g hf hg)
    | expose h => exact .expose (closeNamesComp_typed h f g hf hg)
    | request h k => exact .request (closeNamesValue_typed h f g hf hg) (closeNamesComp_typed k f g hf hg)
    | fail => exact .fail
    | dynamicCall h k => exact .dynamicCall (closeNamesValue_typed h f g hf hg) (closeNamesValue_typed k f g hf hg)
  theorem closeNamesAdapter_typed (h : AdapterTyped xi nu env adapter a b) (f : R → T) (g : S → T)
      (hf : ∀ r, tau (f r) = xi r) (hg : ∀ s, tau (g s) = nu s) :
      AdapterTyped tau emptyTy env (closeNamesAdapter f g adapter) a b := by
    cases h with
    | mk h => exact .mk (closeNamesComp_typed h f g hf hg)
end

end YulangClosure.HigherOrderGraph
